design_rules: Episodes start at one designated spawn point per map.
Maps are large and mostly open.
Walls are partial and openings remain broad.
No maze, dungeon-room chain, long corridor, or precision-navigation layout is generated.
Monster populations use loose spatial clusters and varied regional density.
Respawn timing and redistribution vary across layouts.

Every layout is validated so the bot's real latched-forward controls can regain meaningful movement from any sampled obstacle-adjacent position and heading within a stage-appropriate tick budget; unescapable pockets are rejected and regenerated, never shipped.
